description: Change the address a temporary DNS name points at. Needs the dns_token from create_dns_name. Use it when the machine behind the name moved and you would rather keep the name than hand out a new one. The expiry does not move: the name still disappears 24 hours after it was created. One change per name per 10 seconds.

dns_token.description: The dns_token from create_dns_name. It is shown once and never again.

ip.description: A public unicast IPv4 or IPv6 address. Private, loopback, link-local and multicast ranges are refused. The address is required and never taken from the caller, because the caller is usually not the machine the name should point at.

slug.description: The slug the service assigned, without the aisense- prefix and without the zone.

ttl.description: Seconds. 60 is the only value on the menu, so leave it out unless you want to be explicit.

name: update_dns_name
title: Update a temporary DNS name
